# Daily Briefing – Thursday 12 November

Yesterday was a quieter day — no training session logged and just 4,362 steps, though your body still burned 2,430 kcal, keeping you slightly ahead of your 2,300 target. Sleep at 6.6 hours is a little short of ideal; not disastrous, but worth noting.

Your HRV at 85ms sits below your 91–122ms baseline, which alongside the lighter sleep suggests your body is in a mild recovery dip. Your resting HR of 53 bpm is reassuringly solid though, and stress at 42/100 is manageable. If today has a session planned, keep the intensity moderate — no hard efforts.

With protein at 175g today, prioritise getting it spread across meals rather than back-loaded. And tonight, aim for 7.5–8 hours sleep — that single change will do more for your HRV recovery than almost anything else right now. You've got 180 days. Use them wisely. 💪
